title: A Pareto stays sorted when two causes share a grid step

# A Pareto stays sorted when two causes share a grid step

North prints "<0.1%" and ">99.9%", which are correct. South's Alpha and Beta differ by two defects, so Beta is the largest and is drawn first.

```chart
type: pareto
title: Causes by region
data:
  inline:
    - {region: North, c: Alpha, n: 100000}
    - {region: North, c: Beta, n: 50000}
    - {region: North, c: Gamma, n: 20}
    - {region: South, c: Alpha, n: 1004}
    - {region: South, c: Beta, n: 1006}
    - {region: South, c: Gamma, n: 20}
encoding: {x: c, y: n}
controls:
  - kind: filter
    id: region
    field: region
    label: Region
    options: [North, South]
    initial: North
```
